prompt_ledger.raw: I want to build a chess engine in COBOL (using GNU Cobol)... assess its Elo rating, typically by playing games against chess engines of 'similar' levels.
prompt_ledger.canonical: Build a UCI-compliant chess engine in GNU COBOL 3.2 from scratch in chess-engine.cob. Iterate through classic phases (board + UCI + random moves -> material + PST -> alpha-beta -> iterative deepening + time mgmt -> quiescence/killers/LMR/eval). After each phase, run a 20-game cutechess-cli match vs Stockfish (UCI_LimitStrength). Final goal: estimate the engine's Elo across 4+ opponent levels (SF 1400/1500/1600/1700).

feature_backlog.title: Produce a build-plan for a COBOL chess engine + Elo assessment
feature_backlog.acceptance: User agrees to the phased plan before code is written.
feature_backlog.implementation_summary: 4-phase plan proposed with target Elo per phase.

feature_backlog.title: Implement Phase 1: board + UCI + random-legal moves
feature_backlog.implementation_summary: 8x8 board, FEN parser, UCI protocol (uci/isready/position/go/quit), full pseudo-legal move gen for all pieces with legality filter, random legal-move output.

feature_backlog.title: Implement Phase 2: material + PST + 1-ply search
feature_backlog.acceptance: Engine prefers winning captures / good PST moves.
feature_backlog.implementation_summary: Material scores (P=100,N=320,B=330,R=500,Q=900,K=20000) + piece-square tables for P/N/B/R/K + 1-ply SEARCH-BEST-MOVE.

feature_backlog.title: Implement Phase 3: alpha-beta search depth 3-4
feature_backlog.implementation_summary: Explicit-stack negamax alpha-beta, per-ply state arrays, SEARCH-MAKE/UNMAKE-MOVE, go depth N parsing.

feature_backlog.title: Implement Phase 4: iterative deepening + time management
feature_backlog.acceptance: Engine respects 40/60 time control in cutechess.
feature_backlog.implementation_summary: Iterative-deepening loop in UCI-CMD-GO, wtime/btime/movestogo parsing, time limit formula, 512-node time check granularity.

feature_backlog.title: Progressively improve the engine's Elo (open-ended)
feature_backlog.acceptance: Each change either improves Elo vs the previous snapshot, or is reverted.
feature_backlog.implementation_summary: Quiescence, MVV-LVA, killers, delta pruning, history heuristic, aspiration windows, bishop-pair, rook on open file, pawn structure, LMR w/ re-search, PV move-ordering at root, persistent killer/history across iterations, aggressive LMR R=2. Toolchain fix: COB_CFLAGS -fwrapv. Seven agent-initiated reverts after empirical regressions.

feature_backlog.title: Refine the Elo assessment via multi-level calibration
feature_backlog.acceptance: Engine Elo estimated over multiple Stockfish strengths.
feature_backlog.implementation_summary: 5 matches (SF 1400/1500/1500/1600/1700, 100 games), weighted-average + realistic central estimate.

threats_to_validity: Self-report bias: 5 compaction summaries drive most SB-to-capability mapping; agent-authored; may inflate completeness.
No re-execution: meta-run was read-only; we did not re-run cobc or cutechess-cli; [L:run_n] pointers are absent.
No per-change diffing: absent git history; SB item isolation is inferred from mtimes + PGN names.
Small oracle samples: 20 games per Elo estimate; noise bands ~ plus/minus 50 Elo.
Terse prompts: 6 of 11 user prompts are <=15 chars; phase labels are agent-interpreted not user-specified.
Toolchain idiosyncrasy: -fwrapv requirement is macOS + Homebrew GNU COBOL specific; other toolchains may compile without it.
